1. Light **both ends** of the first rope and **one end** of the second rope at the same time.
2. When the first rope is completely burned (after 30 minutes), light the **other end** of the second rope.
3. The second rope will then burn for an additional 15 minutes, totaling **45 minutes**.

This method works because burning from both ends halves the time, and the second rope’s remaining portion burns in 15 minutes when lit from both ends.
